steps.note: Origin: K-pop trainee posts a 15s routine on TikTok; 2M views in the first hour.
Filipino dance crews duet it; jeepney and mall-food-court versions go viral.
Remixed to a dangdut beat; office-worker versions dominate the For You page.
US creators and a few celebrities pick it up; Venice Beach group takes trend mainstream.
Funk remix and football-team locker-room versions; fastest growth of any region.
